newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, low sulphur fuel slides.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, low sulphur fuel slides.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, trader said.
Naphtha continued firm supported by trade house short-covering, but there was little evidence of the concerted physical demand that many sellers are looking for.

Gasoline was steady but with poor European demand and the difficulty of shipping product transatlantic dampening trade. Prompt Rotterdam refinery liftings for Eurograde traded at $218.75 and $222 a tonne.
Gas oil was about 50 cents easier with futures. Cargo and barge premiums were steady on heating oil demand.
Low sulphur cracked fuel oil fell hard, under the weight of growing avails in northwest Europe and the U.S. High sulphur prices were broadly steady.
